name: @ironflowsh/mcp

tools.name: describe_data
tools.description: Start here for any Hyperliquid question the other tools do not answer directly. Returns the SQL tables you can query with run_query (every fill, per-wallet daily totals, wallet behaviour labels, funding, mark and oracle prices, open interest, liquidations, builder-code fills, transfers, vault flows), their columns, how far back each goes, query tips, worked examples and your own limits.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run one read-only ClickHouse SELECT over Ironflow's Hyperliquid tables (hl.fills, hl.wallet_daily, hl.wallet_behavior, hl.funding, hl.mark_prices, hl.oracle_prices, hl.open_interest, hl.liquidations, hl.builder_fills, hl.transfers, hl.vault_operations). Call describe_data first for columns and examples. Aggregate in SQL: results are capped (1,000 rows keyless). Keyless: last 24 hours, 5 s per query, 60 query seconds per hour per IP; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key gives 30 days of history.

sql.description: One ClickHouse SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) over hl.* tables, without a FORMAT clause

max_rows.description: Most rows to return (default 200, capped by your tier)

tools.name: get_wallet_behavior
tools.description: How Hyperliquid wallets trade, from their last 30 days: labels (market_maker, high_frequency, whale, directional, consistent_winner, big_loser, revenge_sizing, often_liquidated, hip3_trader, spot_trader, prediction_trader) and the numbers behind them (maker share, buy/sell imbalance, fills per day, green-day share, profit factor, liquidations). Look up specific addresses, or list wallets with one label.

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses (up to 50). Omit to list wallets instead.

min_volume_usd.description: Only wallets with at least this 30-day volume

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Latest mark price of a Hyperliquid market: native perps, HIP-3 builder perps (e.g. xyz:NVDA-PERP) and spot.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description: Latest tick-level trades on a Hyperliquid market from our own nodes: price, size, side and block time. Covers native perps, HIP-3 builder markets, HIP-4 outcomes and spot.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

limit.description: Number of trades to return (1-100, default 20)

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles for a Hyperliquid market, computed from tick-level trades.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

limit.description: Number of candles to return (1-500, default 24)

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Hourly funding rate history for a Hyperliquid perp, including HIP-3 builder perps. A positive rate means longs pay shorts.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

limit.description: Number of funding rate entries (1-100, default 10)

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Latest open interest for a Hyperliquid perp.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Liquidations on a Hyperliquid perp, read from our own nodes: price, size, side and the liquidated wallet. Hyperliquid's public API has no liquidation feed.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

tools.name: get_liquidation_summary
tools.description: Liquidations across every Hyperliquid market (or one market) over the last N minutes, totalled: count, notional, longs vs shorts liquidated, the top markets and the largest single liquidation. Use it for 'who got liquidated in the last hour?'. Keyless calls can look back 60 minutes, keyed calls up to 240.

tools.name: get_fills
tools.description: Every fill for one Hyperliquid wallet, optionally for one market, from indexed history: price, size, side, fee and realized PnL. Hyperliquid's own userFills endpoints stop at the 10,000 most recent fills.

market.description: Optional market filter — native HL (e.g. "BTC-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP")

tools.name: get_mark_prices
tools.description: Mark price and oracle price series for a Hyperliquid perp.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP")

tools.name: get_vault_operations
tools.description: Deposits into and withdrawals from Hyperliquid vaults. Pass a vault address, a depositor address, or both; one is required.

tools.name: get_liquidation_levels
tools.description: Liquidated notional on a Hyperliquid perp bucketed by price: where longs and shorts were wiped out. Needs a Builder or Enterprise key; keyless and free-key calls return 403.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP")

tools.name: get_vault_leaderboard
tools.description: Hyperliquid vaults ranked by net deposits. Needs a Builder or Enterprise key; keyless and free-key calls return 403.

tools.name: get_funding_stats
tools.description: Funding statistics per time bucket for a Hyperliquid perp: average, minimum, maximum and annualized rate.

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP")

tools.name: get_user_state
tools.description: Open positions and unrealized PnL for a Hyperliquid wallet right now, across native and HIP-3 perps. Use it for questions like 'is this wallet long or short?'

tools.name: get_user_funding
tools.description: Funding a Hyperliquid wallet paid or received, per market per bucket. Positive means received, negative means paid. bucket=1d gives daily totals, 1h the raw hourly payments.

tools.name: get_user_maker_taker
tools.description: Maker vs taker breakdown of a Hyperliquid wallet's fills per market: volume, fees and rebates. A high maker share with negative maker fees marks a market maker.

tools.name: get_user_ledger
tools.description: Vault deposits, withdrawals and transfers for a Hyperliquid wallet. Positive amounts go into the account. Account deposits and withdrawals are recorded only up to 2026-06-06.

tools.name: get_pnl_leaderboard
tools.description: Every Hyperliquid wallet ranked by realized PnL, biggest losses or volume over a window. Wallets with fewer than 5 fills in the window are left out.

tools.name: get_market_top_wallets
tools.description: Top wallets on one Hyperliquid market by volume or realized PnL, up to 200 rows.

tools.name: get_markets_snapshot
tools.description: Active Hyperliquid markets ranked in one call: mark price, 24h change, 24h volume, open interest and current hourly funding. Sort by abs_funding for the most extreme funding, abs_change_24h for the biggest movers, or volume (default). Use min_volume_usd to skip illiquid markets. Returns the top 25 unless limit is set.

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code (e.g. 'xyz'). Omit to include every issuer.

sort_by.description: Ranking key (default volume). funding_rate is hourly; positive means longs pay shorts.

min_volume_usd.description: Skip markets with less 24h volume than this (USD)

tools.name: get_user_summary
tools.description: One Hyperliquid wallet's stats over a window: volume, realized PnL, fill count, win rate, maker share and markets traded.

tools.name: get_wallet_labels
tools.description: Labels for notable Hyperliquid wallets: top whales by 24h volume, top traders by 30-day realized PnL, vaults and vault leaders. Pass addresses to check specific wallets; without them it lists the whales and smart money.

addresses.description: Comma-separated wallet addresses to look up

whale_top_n.description: Top N whales to include (max 500, default 100)

smart_top_n.description: Top N smart-money wallets to include (max 500, default 100)

tools.name: get_user_pnl_series
tools.description: Realized PnL curve of a Hyperliquid wallet over time, bucketed (for example hourly or daily).

tools.name: get_top_traders
tools.description: Hyperliquid traders ranked across all markets by results over 7, 30 or 90 days: win rate, profit factor, realized PnL, max drawdown and best markets. sort=top ranks by realized PnL, lowrisk by smallest max drawdown, new by most recently first seen.

tools.name: get_market_leaders
tools.description: The best traders on one Hyperliquid market, ranked by profit factor then win rate, among wallets with at least 5 closed trades there.

tools.name: get_early_movers
tools.description: Wallets whose large orders (at least $10k) on a Hyperliquid market were followed by a price move in their direction within 30 minutes. Returns a lead score in basis points and a hit rate per wallet. Past activity does not predict future results.

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: A Hyperliquid wallet's trading record over 7, 30 or 90 days: win rate, profit factor, realized PnL, max drawdown and its best markets.

tools.name: list_cohorts
tools.description: List available address cohorts: six predefined groups (top_pnl_30d, high_volume_30d, whale_fills, net_withdrawers_7d, liquidation_prone, vault_whales) plus any custom cohorts the caller has created

tools.name: get_cohort_addresses
tools.description: Get the wallet addresses in a specific cohort

name.description: Cohort name (e.g. top_pnl_30d, high_volume_30d, whale_fills, or a custom cohort name)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get system status, data freshness, and venue health (unauthenticated)

tools.name: get_status_metrics
tools.description: Get rolling-window API + pipeline + synthetic performance metrics (unauthenticated)

tools.name: get_status_history
tools.description: Get an uptime / freshness timeline. period: '24h' (default) or '7d' (unauthenticated)

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Active Hyperliquid markets with display symbol, class (perp, spot, prediction), HIP-3 issuer and base asset. Use search to find how a market is named (e.g. search 'nvda' finds xyz:NVDA-PERP).

market_class.description: Market class. Omit to return perp + spot + prediction. 'prediction' filters to HIP-4 outcome contracts.

issuer.description: HIP-3 issuer code (e.g. 'flx'). Pass empty string '' to return only native non-builder markets. Omit to include every issuer.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on symbol, base asset or Hyperliquid coin

instructions: Read-only Hyperliquid market data from Ironflow's own nodes: trades, candles, funding, open interest, liquidations, mark prices, market snapshots and wallet analytics for native perps, HIP-3 builder markets and spot. Markets use display symbols such as BTC-PERP or xyz:NVDA-PERP; call list_markets when unsure. For anything the named tools do not cover, call describe_data and then run_query with ClickHouse SQL over the hl.* tables. Keyless use allows 10 requests per minute and 24 hours of history; a free key from https://ironflow.sh/key raises that to 60 per minute and 30 days.
